data.explanation: This is your yearly gas settlement (Jahresabrechnung). It compares the actual cost of the gas you used during the period with the monthly advance payments (Abschläge) you already paid, and the difference — €169.24 — is now owed to the provider. Transfer this amount to the IBAN given by the deadline shown; the letter also says partial payments can be arranged by agreement if you can't pay it all at once. If you miss the deadline, the provider may send a reminder or charge late-payment interest. Check the consumption figures against your own meter readings before paying, and contact the provider if something looks wrong.
